rationale: This is essentially a cosmetic re-parameterization of the archived "R&D Debt-Wall Acceleration" (ACCEL→DELTA of R&D intensity, (dlc−che)/at→dlc/lt) and overlaps the maturity-tilt leg of "R&D Maturity-Matched Financing," so it adds no new mechanism.

The expression is close to the sign-flipped union of two archived signals ("R&D Liability-Growth Spiral" and "R&D Accumulated-Deficit Repair"/"R&D No-Tax Deficit Drift"), making it a recombination rather than a new mechanism.

GROWTH(cogs/sale) is mechanically the negative of gross-margin growth, so this reproduces the archived R&D × margin-erosion × current-liability structure ("R&D Margin-Trough Current Burden," "R&D Liability-Growth Spiral") with a swapped margin proxy.

The cash-versus-current-liability leg duplicates "Goodwill Liquidity Squeeze"/"Goodwill Net-Debt Collateral Gap," and the only increment (dlc/lt maturity share) is too thin to constitute a distinct hypothesis in a family already showing consistently negative but fmb-insignificant results.

Conditioning goodwill accretion on subsequent operating cash-flow and margin deterioration is a substantively different second leg from the financing-side "Debt-Financed Goodwill Accretion" (whose fmb/alpha signs disagreed), and the expression's direction matches the stated negative sign, though it remains adjacent to the well-documented acquirer-underperformance anomaly.

The intan/at × lt/at core replicates "Identifiable Intangibles Tangible-Leverage Trap," and the added NEG(DELTA(intan/at)) leg is mechanically correlated with the intangible level through routine amortization, so it captures scale rather than impairment risk.
